name: Atlas Energy Solutions Inc.
summary:
Atlas Energy Solutions (AESI) reported a loss of $0.18 per share on revenue of $293.18 million for the second quarter ended June 2026. The consensus estimate was a loss of $0.12 per share on revenue of $275.58 million. The company missed consensus estimates by 50.00% while revenue grew 1.56% on a year-over-year basis.

Atlas is a leader in the proppant and proppant logistics industry and is currently solely focused on serving customers in the Permian Basin of West Texas and New Mexico, the most active oil and natural gas producing regions in North America.
subject: Atlas Energy Solutions Missed Consensus Estimates
